name: Django
database_layer: Django ORM with psycopg 3.3 (C extension); persistent connections (CONN_MAX_AGE), one per thread, 16 in total
logging: none (Gunicorn's access log is off; Django logs only warnings and errors)

phase2.validation: <int:id> path converter (404); Django forms for the query string (Form(request.GET)), the JSON body (Form(json.loads(body)), plus a JSON integer check) and the form (Form(request.POST)): 422; malformed JSON 400

csrf.mechanism: CsrfViewMiddleware: secret in the csrftoken cookie, masked csrfmiddlewaretoken field, Origin checked when present; 403

session.mechanism: django.contrib.auth (LoginView, AuthenticationMiddleware) with the database session backend (django_session); custom user model on users, BCryptPasswordHasher

structure_note: Python 3.15.2, the newest Django 6.1 supports (FastAPI runs 3.14.10)
notes: startproject settings with the deployment checklist applied; HTTPS settings stay off (no TLS).
